name: Connections — Slack
description: Slack connector: channels, history, search, messages, reactions via the connections framework

feature.label: Slack connection (OAuth)
feature.description: Slack connector for the external connections framework

vars.description: Slack OAuth v2 client ID for the Slack connector.

instructions: 1. Create an app at https://api.slack.com/apps (from scratch).
2. Under OAuth & Permissions → User Token Scopes add: channels:read, groups:read, channels:history, groups:history, search:read, chat:write, reactions:write, users:read.
3. Under OAuth & Permissions → Redirect URLs add: <ENGENTY_API_BASE_URL>/api/connections/oauth/callback.
4. Copy the Client ID from Basic Information → App Credentials.

vars.description: Slack OAuth v2 client secret for the Slack connector.

instructions: Copy the Client Secret from Basic Information → App Credentials of the same Slack app.
